summary: Equinix filed an 8-K reporting entry into a new $5.5 billion senior unsecured multi-currency revolving credit facility on July 27, 2026, replacing prior credit arrangements. The facility matures July 25, 2031, with Equinix and two European financing subsidiaries as co-borrowers, and a syndicate led by Bank of America as administrative agent. This is a routine corporate financing transaction, not a special situation. No change in control, capital structure event, or strategic action is involved. The filing pertains solely to ordinary credit-line execution, so it does not qualify for any special-situations category.
